changes.name: Barrow Knight
changes.flavor: The armor walks, and something wears it back.
changes.crunch: Dark +50%, Holy −50%; Poison immune; Body and Arms Durability +30%; healing received −50%; a Knight for good; the armor is their head, body, arms and legs; cannot enter the Chapel.

changes.name: Marsh Thing
changes.flavor: It drips. It remembers being someone.
changes.crunch: Poison immune; whoever strikes it is Poisoned; starts every battle with Regen; moves one cell at a time; eats 1 Essence a Year.

changes.name: Seraph Husk
changes.flavor: Something holy moved out, and left the light on.
changes.crunch: Holy +50%, Dark −50%; healing dealt +25%; Sanity ceiling −30%; burns 1 Essence a Year; no helm fits the halo.

changes.name: Wyrmling
changes.flavor: Scales first, then the hunger, then the fire.
changes.crunch: Fire +50%, Water −30%; every attack is Fire; fights with claws that grow with them; no hands for weapons or gloves; eats 4 Grain a Year; too big for the Chapel.
